set.prevailing_wage_basis: 24 CFR 983.153(c) (PBV development requirements, labor standards): for development (new construction or rehabilitation) involving nine or more contract units, the owner and its contractors must pay Davis-Bacon wages, and the PHA must monitor compliance; existing housing placed under a HAP contract without development activity is not covered. Federal Davis-Bacon only; PBVs alone do not trigger California prevailing wage. Source: eCFR 24 CFR part 983, https://www.ecfr.gov/current/title-24/subtitle-B/chapter-IX/part-983/subpart-D/section-983.153

reason: No PBV RFP is posted on YCH's procurement page, and 24 CFR 983.153(c) sets Davis-Bacon for PBV development of nine or more contract units.
